derivation: from H2734 (חָרָה) in the original sense of H2352 (חוּר) or H2353 (חוּר);
def: a linen corslet (as white or hollow)

occurrences.text: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
